description: Company identity, ticker, current price, and filing-date timing anchors.
plain_language_formula: Display company identity and current price; use filing dates to anchor forecast periods.
notes: Filing-date-driven timing is absent from Alpha Forge. Forecast year labels are derived from historical dates rather than explicit seed dates.
recommended_next_inspection: Add last filing date and next filing date to the shared model contract.

description: Global tax rate, risk-free rate, and market risk premium that should propagate through the workbook.
calculation_layer: fragmented across frontend tabs and backend defaults
plain_language_formula: Use one shared tax rate, risk-free rate, and market risk premium everywhere they are needed downstream.
notes: Assumptions tab is display-only. There is no canonical shared assumption store.
recommended_next_inspection: Define a shared assumptions owner and remove duplicated tax/RFR/MRP logic.

description: Segment-level historical and projected revenue drivers.
plain_language_formula: Project each revenue segment separately, then sum the segments into total revenue.
notes: Future-state note exists, but there is no segment schema or segment rollup in the AAPL path.
recommended_next_inspection: Introduce segment arrays in schema and define segment-to-total rollup ownership.

description: Historical total revenue, projected total revenue, and user growth inputs.
downstream_dependents: Revenue chart only in current implementation
plain_language_formula: Start from last historical total revenue and apply each projected growth rate in sequence to get future total revenue.
notes: RevenueTab does not publish its edited growth rates to Projections or DCF.
recommended_next_inspection: Make revenue edits feed the authoritative projection model.

description: Projected revenue through net income lines.
plain_language_formula: Project revenue, apply gross margin and operating cost assumptions, then derive operating profit, earnings before tax, tax provision, and net income.
notes: The workbook expects this tree to feed DCF. Alpha Forge keeps it isolated to the tab.
recommended_next_inspection: Export projections into shared state or backend model output.

description: Placement of D&A in the operating-profit bridge.
observed_upstream_dependencies: D&A rendered separately but not deducted in operating profit
plain_language_formula: Subtract D&A before operating profit, then add D&A back later in free cash flow.
notes: Projected operating profit excludes D&A while common-size display includes it in OpEx.
recommended_next_inspection: Reconcile EBIT and EBITDA construction against workbook sequence.

description: Projected CAPEX, NWC, and change in NWC.
downstream_dependents: Forecast terms table only in current implementation
plain_language_formula: Apply CAPEX percent and NWC percent assumptions to projected revenue, then calculate year-over-year change in NWC.
notes: The structure is present but does not feed the DCF tab.
recommended_next_inspection: Connect these forecast terms directly into the shared DCF engine.

description: Debt, diluted shares, price, market value of equity, and capital weights.
plain_language_formula: Multiply diluted shares by price to get market value of equity, add debt for total capital, then divide each capital source by total capital to get weights.
notes: The AAPL fixture leaves shares blank because `company.sharesOutstanding` is null.
recommended_next_inspection: Use the same share-count fallback strategy across WACC and DCF.

description: Risk-free rate, beta, MRP, CAPM, cost of debt, after-tax cost of debt, and final WACC.
persistence_state: local state only with callback emission
plain_language_formula: Calculate cost of equity from risk-free rate plus beta times market risk premium, calculate after-tax cost of debt from pre-tax cost and tax rate, then weight both costs by capital weights to get WACC.
notes: Structure and formulas are faithful. The main gap is that these assumptions are not owned by the Assumptions tab.
recommended_next_inspection: Move ownership into a shared assumptions model.

description: Subject company market data, financial data, and headline multiples.
plain_language_formula: Build subject equity value and enterprise value, then divide by revenue, EBITDA, and net income to get the multiples.
notes: Subject diluted shares are derived from market cap and price because fixture shares are null.

description: High, quartiles, average, median, and low for peer multiples.
observed_upstream_dependencies: analysis.peers with precomputed multiples or enriched multiples
plain_language_formula: Take peer multiples, exclude negative values and extreme outliers from percentile and average calculations, then compute the distribution statistics.
notes: This is one of the closer matches to the workbook.
recommended_next_inspection: Add explicit peer-selection inputs when ticker-driven peer loading expands.

description: Peer-implied prices for EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA, and P/E plus bull/neutral/bear scenarios.
persistence_state: computed on render and emitted upward
plain_language_formula: Apply peer multiple statistics to the subject company metrics, convert enterprise values to equity values where needed, then divide by diluted shares to get implied prices.
notes: Neutral outputs are emitted to Final Valuation via parent state.
recommended_next_inspection: Add explicit peer-loading provenance to audit readiness for dynamic comps.

description: Legacy backend DCF result used as a seed source in the current app.
plain_language_formula: Project free cash flow from a single growth rate, discount those cash flows with a fixed WACC, add a terminal value using perpetual growth, then convert enterprise value to equity value per share.
notes: This is not the displayed workbook-like DCF. It is a seed/legacy path.
recommended_next_inspection: Decide whether to retire or formalize this payload as a seed-only artifact.

description: Frontend FCFF path from projected operating metrics through present value and exit multiple.
plain_language_formula: Project revenue and operating profit from seeded ratios, calculate NOPAT, add back D&A, subtract change in NWC and capital expenditures, discount the resulting FCFF stream, add an exit-multiple terminal value, then convert enterprise value to equity value per share.
notes: This FCFF tree does not consume RevenueTab or ProjectionsTab edits and deviates on D&A treatment.
recommended_next_inspection: Make FCFF consume the authoritative projections model.

description: Frontend FCFE path from FCFF adjustments through present value and P/E exit.
observed_upstream_dependencies: WACC model CAPM or DCF constants
plain_language_formula: Start from FCFF-style operating cash flow, subtract after-tax interest expense, add net borrowing, discount the resulting FCFE stream at cost of equity, then add a terminal value using a P/E exit and convert to per-share value.
notes: Net borrowing is repeated as a flat annual amount rather than a workbook-like debt path.
recommended_next_inspection: Model net borrowing from projected debt movement or explicit user assumptions.

description: WACC versus EV/EBITDA and cost of equity versus P/E sensitivity grids.
plain_language_formula: Hold the operating model constant and recompute implied per-share values across a grid of discount rates and exit multiples.
notes: These are downstream summaries and largely match workbook intent.
recommended_next_inspection: Tie the grid centers back to shared assumption ownership.

description: User-controlled weighting between DCF and relative valuation outputs.
plain_language_formula: Multiply the DCF and relative valuation implied prices by their chosen weights, sum each FCFE and FCFF pair separately, then average the two weighted outputs.
notes: Weight dependency is correct even though default weights differ from the workbook.
recommended_next_inspection: Persist user weighting if workflow requires session continuity.

plain_language_formula: Sort analyst targets by most recent publication date and display them as downstream reference information.
notes: AAPL fixture does not include analyst target data, so the section renders as empty state.
recommended_next_inspection: Confirm whether analyst targets belong in the canonical backend payload.
